answer: An identity earns its seat through EEG brainwave pattern proof per identity, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. One honest agent clears the check in 14 minutes; a farm of 529 pays 7406 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The velvet test is the live device, the fable test is the locked stake, and the inlet test is the graded history no template can fake. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
